# UtilityCraft: Digital Storage v1.1.1

This update cleans up item names and interface labels while preserving descriptive tooltips in all five supported languages.

> [!WARNING]
> Requires UtilityCraft 3.6.1 or newer.

## UI/UX

- Separated item and block names from their descriptive tooltips in all five supported languages, preserving descriptions, formatting, and addon attribution.
- Removed addon signatures from internal UI items so machine information panels and interface placeholders no longer display them.
